description: This file implements a gRPC probe for Kubernetes, providing functionality to check the health status of gRPC services via health checks, including connection handling, error processing, and status evaluation.

classes.name: grpcProber
classes.description: Implementation of the Prober interface for gRPC health checks.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of grpcProber.

methods.name: Probe
methods.description: Performs a gRPC health check by establishing a connection, sending a health check request, and interpreting the response to determine service health.
